reason: The README clearly identifies the plugin as a DeepSeek Harness tool for end-to-end proteomics data analysis: it takes user-provided expression and sample information, executes a defined sequence of statistical and enrichment analyses, and returns summaries plus figures and interpretation outputs. This aligns primarily with data processing and workflow automation within the platform rather than code generation, UI theming, or collaboration features.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可对话式的蛋白组学分析能力，用户提供数据文件并确认分组后即可自动完成标准化、PCA、批次校正、差异分析和富集分析，并输出结果汇总与解读。
summaries.en: This plugin provides conversational proteomics analysis in DeepSeek Harness, taking user data files and guided inputs to run normalization, PCA, batch correction, differential analysis, enrichment analyses, and return summarized interpretation outputs.

capabilities: Ingests user-provided proteomics data and sample metadata through the agent workflow
Runs a multi-step proteomics analysis pipeline including normalization, PCA, batch correction, differential analysis, enrichment analysis, and GSEA
Generates summaries, figures, and interpretation-style reports from analysis outputs
May install and initialize a local R runtime and package environment on first run

reasons.code: README explicitly describes a plug-and-play proteomics analysis workflow exposed through DeepSeek Harness conversation: normalization → PCA → batch correction → differential analysis → GO/KEGG enrichment → GSEA.
README states users provide data files and answer guided questions about columns and group comparisons, and the plugin performs end-to-end analysis and reporting.
README notes automatic detection or silent installation of its own R 4.4.0 runtime and package library on first use.
